title: Jason Fagone (author, The Woman Who Smashed Codes) — 'Eric writes with passion and precision about the wrecking ball of big-money investing'
summary: Fagone is the bestselling author of The Woman Who Smashed Codes, about the codebreaker Elizebeth Friedman, with The Husband Simulation to come. His post marking Friedman's birthday ends with a short run of reading recommendations, and Incorruptible is among them. Eric was an early supporter of Fagone's book a decade ago and sent him this one.
blockquote: Eric writes with passion and precision about the wrecking ball of big-money investing, how Wall Street and private equity turn companies with integrity into rubble. He tells a number of infuriating stories that resonated with me. I remember my father going through this when I was a kid, at his company, which was bought and drained by a private equity firm. Eric proposes solutions that feel human and also achievable. I didn't expect to be moved by a "business" book but I was.
attribution_title: Author, The Woman Who Smashed Codes (NYT bestseller) · Forthcoming: The Husband Simulation
